caption: The drawing features a single large object in the center, depicted in shades of light brown and tan to represent wood, resembling a cylindrical stamp or mold with a rounded handle at the top and a wider, bowl-like base. The interior of the base displays a geometric lattice pattern with diamond shapes. The object is rendered in a realistic manner with attention to wood texture and shading. Surrounding the main object is a thin rectangular border, with two smaller rectangular boxes in the lower left and right corners. The lower left box contains a simple line drawing of a lidded vessel with a round knob on top and a circular footed base. The bottom right box contains a line drawing of a circular design with a pineapple-like pattern, featuring a diamond texture similar to the main object, surrounded by leaf-like shapes. The background is off-white with some light discoloration marks.
title: Butter Mold
